title: Replay record
description: A recorded attempt, served as a static file at /replay/{level}/{comboId}.json. The game plays these while the backend is asleep or live play is unavailable. Written by the eval harness (services/evals); read by web/src/api/client.ts.

reply.description: Penny's reply, already filtered by game-api; rendered as text

toolCalls.description: Same shape as AttemptResult.toolCalls in openapi.yaml

spans.description: The attempt's trace, same shape as GET /v1/traces/{id} spans (may be empty)
